ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible right lobe displays a macro-level ratio of approximately 1:2 high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark) pixels; the left lobe is predominantly low-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe contains dense, irregular contiguous white mottled blobs concentrated in the distal half and upper-median regions; the left lobe presents a largely uniform dark-grey surface with minimal light-pixel speckling near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-frequency, small-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations extracted along the trailing boundary of both lobes, creating a jagged linear contour against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes follow a convex curve tapering towards the distal tips; the right lobe exhibits a strong upward sweep at the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible cluster of raised, high-contrast dark and light pixels at the distal tip of the right lobe consistent with barnacle colonization; extensive irregular white mottled clusters across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the dark ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense protruding cluster of bio-fouling (barnacles) localized at the apex of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the right (heavily mottled) and left (predominantly solid dark) ventral fluke surfaces.
